name: patent-disclosure-skill
description: 中国专利.skill：专利点挖掘与交底书（发明/实用/外观）编写，通俗解读专利，嗅探政策动向，辅助审查答复。
one_liner: An AI skill that helps Chinese inventors find patentable ideas in their work and draft the formal invention disclosure document.
buyer: A small Chinese hardware or manufacturing company that has new designs but no in-house patent expertise.
business_use_cases: A small hardware startup drafts its first invention disclosure without paying a patent agent's hourly rate upfront.
A patent agency uses it to speed up first-draft disclosures for high-volume filing clients, then reviews and polishes.
An R&D team tracks relevant patent-policy changes automatically instead of manually monitoring government filings.

money_ideas.idea: Offer an "AI-drafted, human-reviewed" patent disclosure service to small manufacturers who can't afford a full patent agent engagement.
License it to patent agencies as a productivity tool sold per seat.

steal_this: Partner with a patent agent this weekend and offer a cut-rate "first draft disclosure" service to small manufacturers as a lead-in to full patent filing.
